description: metal: add F16 input to the FWHT ( #29094 ) metal: add F16 input to the FWHT The Metal FWHT kernel accepts F32 input only. The pipeline name now carries the source type, and supports_op accepts an F16 src1 for the Hadamard hint at the four sizes the kernels cover.
